00036 void dmatrix_lu_dcmp( dmatrix_t *mat_in )
00037 {
00038         long int i,j,k;
00039         long int size = mat_in->nrows < mat_in->ncols ? mat_in->nrows : mat_in->ncols;
00040         double tau;
00041         for(i=0;i<size;i++) // mat_in(i,i), size => nrows
00042         {
00043                 for(j=i+1;j<mat_in->nrows;j++) // mat_in(i+1,i), mat_in(i+2,i), ...
00044                 {
00045                         tau = mat_in->start[j*mat_in->rsize+i] / mat_in->start[i*mat_in->rsize+i];
00046                         for(k=i+1;k<mat_in->ncols;k++)
00047                                 mat_in->start[j*mat_in->rsize+k] = mat_in->start[j*mat_in->rsize+k]
00048                                                                         - tau * mat_in->start[i*mat_in->rsize+k];
00049                         mat_in->start[j*mat_in->rsize+i] = tau;
00050                 }
00051         }
00052 }

00059 void dmatrix_fb_sub_vrhs( dmatrix_t *mat_in, dvector_t *rhs_in )
00060 {
00061         long int i,j;
00062         register double sum;
00063         assert( rhs_in->length == mat_in->ncols && mat_in->nrows == mat_in->ncols );
00064         int size = mat_in->nrows;
00065         for(i=1;i<size;i++)
00066         {
00067                 sum = rhs_in->start[i*rhs_in->rsize];
00068                 for(j=0;j<i;j++)
00069                         sum -= mat_in->start[i*mat_in->rsize+j] * rhs_in->start[j*rhs_in->rsize];
00070                 rhs_in->start[i*rhs_in->rsize] = sum;
00071         }
00072         for(i=size-1;i>=0;i--)
00073         {
00074                 sum = rhs_in->start[i*rhs_in->rsize];
00075                 for(j=size-1;j>i;j--)
00076                         sum -= mat_in->start[i*mat_in->rsize+j] * rhs_in->start[j*rhs_in->rsize];
00077                 sum /= mat_in->start[i*mat_in->rsize+i];
00078                 rhs_in->start[i*rhs_in->rsize] = sum;
00079         }
00080 }
